profile.name: Abolfazl Keshavarz
profile.role: Computer Science graduate · Software & systems engineer
profile.headline: Computer science graduate who ships complete systems — hardware to deployment.
profile.lede: Backend services, Linux infrastructure, IoT hardware, and the networks that connect them. RadGard, a production vehicle GPS platform, was built solo end to end — tracker firmware to fleet dashboard.
profile.aboutImageCaption: Rasht, Iran — bench, boards and a server rack that doubles as a lab.
aboutParagraphs: I'm a Computer Science graduate from the University of Guilan and a software/IT engineer who works across the full depth of a system — embedded hardware and networking at the bottom, backend services and databases in the middle, web interfaces and deployment on top.

Most of what I build ends up in someone's hands: a production GPS-tracking platform for vehicles, a warranty system for a home-appliance business, a face-recognition attendance kiosk for a factory floor, a gym management system running in Persian. Alongside that, two years teaching programming to roughly 150 students and a digital-twin research review.
Next is an MSc in Genoa, with an eye toward robotics, AI, and research.

projects.title: RadGard
projects.description: A complete Iranian fleet-tracking ecosystem for cars and motorcycles — from a GPS/GSM tracker unit through cellular telemetry to a live fleet map. Firmware, backend, dashboard and deployment all built solo; currently running as a real product.

detailFields.v: ESP32 unit with NEO-6M GPS and a SIM800C GSM/GPRS modem, reporting over MQTT
Go (Gin) · Paho MQTT ingest · PostgreSQL history + Redis latest-state cache · JWT auth · REST and WebSocket push
React · TypeScript · Zustand · MapLibre GL over self-hosted OpenStreetMap tiles
Linux VPS · NGINX · Mosquitto broker · Docker · TileServer GL · SSL on a custom domain

projects.title: Guarantee Management System
projects.description: Warranty lifecycle platform for a home-appliance business: guarantees created, approved, renewed and cancelled; technicians, customers, products, repairs and spare-part requests tracked across roles, with global search and invoice/repair-image uploads.

projects.title: Personnel Attendance System
projects.tagline: Face-recognition attendance for a factory floor
projects.description: Staff clock in and out by face at a tablet kiosk that keeps working through network drops — recognition runs in the browser, not on a server. Pairs with an admin panel for duty descriptions and daily/weekly/monthly reporting, fully Persian and RTL with Jalali dates and Tehran time.

projects.title: Nosrati Gym Management
projects.description: Persian, right-to-left public site plus admin panel for a gym and corrective-movement centre: memberships with printable cards, physician referral letters, subscription plans, coaches, weekly class schedules and articles, with Excel/CSV and print/PDF reporting.

projects.title: Chatters
projects.description: A messaging platform built to be run on your own server rather than someone else's: Go backend, web client, and a documented VPS deployment path with Compose profiles for HTTP and HTTPS, nginx in front, and a phase-based database migration workflow.

projects.title: Plant Disease Classification
projects.description: Binary image classifier separating fungal-infected plants from healthy ones, built on Ultralytics YOLO11x over a custom dataset as part of a research effort into deep learning for agricultural disease detection. Reached 100% top-1 accuracy on the held-out test set.

projects.title: DeepFakeDetector
projects.description: Bachelor's final project: a computer-vision pipeline that classifies images as real or AI-generated, trained and evaluated on the DF-Platter multi-face deepfake dataset.

projects.title: Body Vitals Monitor
projects.tagline: ESP32 vitals station with an HTTP API
projects.description: An ESP32 driving two I²C medical sensors at once — MAX30205 for body temperature, MAX30100 for heart rate and SpO₂ — with a 0.96" OLED readout and a small JSON API (/api/vitals, /api/temp, /api/info) so other systems can pull the measurements.

projects.title: Live Health Monitor
projects.tagline: ESP8266 pulse oximeter with onboard web UI
projects.description: A standalone ESP8266 pulse oximeter: MAX30100 sensor, OLED display, and an onboard web server in AP mode that serves live BPM and SpO₂ readings refreshed every second — no internet connection or external app required.

projects.title: RFID Attendance System
projects.description: An earlier take on the attendance problem before face recognition: an RFID reader on a microcontroller logging card taps as check-in and check-out events.

experience.description: Taught electronics, Python, programming fundamentals and Django to roughly 150 students; several worked toward CS50 Python certification.
Systematic literature review plus framework and standards analysis, working toward a digital-twin ecosystem architecture.
Website management and day-to-day web technical support.
Supported two programming courses over consecutive terms, running lab sessions and reviewing student code.
Diagnostics and repair on computer hardware and power supplies.
